item.title: Explainer: The latest science on ocean acidification
item.description: In 2025, scientists warned the ‘planetary boundary’ for ocean acidification had been crossed. This is what that means and why it matters.

item.title: Changing diets amid a changing climate
item.description: Much attention has been paid to switching from meat-based diets to plant-based ones. Less attention has been paid to the effects of climate change on the quality and quantity of plant foods.

item.title: Robin Pho joins Tsao Pao Chee Group to lead new energy transition business
item.description: The Singaporean clean energy entrepreneur best known for re-engineering a family oil and gas manpower firm into a solar provider, will set up a new business unit focused on low-carbon growth for the Chinese conglomerate.

item.title: South Korea, China expand cooperation on climate, industry and technology
item.description: New agreements update 2014 environment pact and expand collaboration to carbon markets, digital technology and supply chains.

item.title: Q&A: Five key climate questions for China’s next ‘five-year plan’
item.description: China’s central and local governments, as well as state-owned enterprises, are busy preparing for the next five-year planning period, spanning 2026-2030.

item.title: Philippines adopts mandatory ISSB-based sustainability reporting standards
item.description: The Philippines Securities and Exchange Commission is officially requiring large publicly-listed companies to start applying rules by the International Sustainability Standards Board to measure and disclose their sustainability performance.

item.title: Japan approves record $780 billion draft budget for 2026, ramps up green transition and nuclear spending
item.description: The 2026 fiscal plan boosts funding for renewables, next-generation nuclear power and data-centre decarbonisation as the country works towards its 2050 net zero goal.

item.title: What's next for US climate policy under Trump?
item.description: As President Donald Trump heads into the second year of his second term, climate scientists worry about his anti-climate posture.

item.title: China’s wind farms can protect migratory birds, if well placed
item.description: Wind turbines are key to addressing climate change but should be located away from bird flyways, experts say.

item.title: China’s five green economy challenges in 2026
item.description: Addressing energy wastage and taming manufacturing overcapacity are among the domestic issues that China must address as it strives to meet its climate goals.
